prompt_text:
summarize this in brief "Techline/LB: Pre-screened unsuccessful, no answer {{ORGANIZATION}} (NAM JUST  RINGS)  sent email (N) sent SMS Messages (N) set followup for next business day
 Techline/(JM): Pre-screen unsuccessful, no answer LMOM (N, RANG FOR 1:30) sent email (Y) sent SMS Messages (N) set follow up for next business day.
 Thechline (IL) {{NAME}} called in, dishwasher not draining, made sure nothing stuck in pump, pump is running, drain hose seems to be clear, drained into bucket not draining, Gave part numbers a00126401 drain pump, 807117001 drain hose.
 1.20.22// OEM CM Shemarro// AOM TOOL/{{SJ_NUMBER}}// Major Appliance - SS Task - Backlog//COD/Bonnye Best/ Accepted/Frigidaire Dishwasher/ appointment 1.20.22//checking chat for update - parts ordered // 1.14.22 807117001 (25) HOSE,DRAIN Delivered 1.18.22 | 1.14.22 A00126401 DISHWASHER DRAIN PUMP Delivered 1.18.22 / shipped to the FSL //called cm to confirm scheduled appointment no answer kept ringing  nfan set follow up for 1.24.22
 Replaced drain pump and hose. Ran system to ensure it drains. Running properly LE
 {{NAME}} customer calling in to check status \r\nverified name, confirmed address & email\r\nsent follow-up to {{NAME}}"
response_text:
**Brief Summary**

- **Pre‑screen attempts**: Two Techline agents (LB and JM) tried to contact customers but received no answer. Emails and SMS were sent (only JM’s email was sent), and follow‑ups were scheduled for the next business day.  
- **Dishwasher issue**: A customer in IL called about a non‑draining dishwasher. The technician inspected the pump and hose, identified the need for a new drain pump (part A00126401) and drain hose (part 807117001).  
- **Parts & service**: Parts were ordered on 1/14/22, delivered on 1/18/22, and shipped to the field service location. The technician replaced the pump and hose, ran the unit to confirm proper drainage, and confirmed the dishwasher was functioning correctly.  
- **Customer follow‑up**: The customer called again to check status; the agent verified the customer’s identity, address, and email, and sent a follow‑up message.
